relationships.subject: Endocannabinoids
relationships.evidence_quote: Endocannabinoids are released on demand from postsynaptic terminals and travels retrograde to stimulate cannabinoids receptors on presynaptic terminals, inhibiting the release of excitatory neurotransmitters

key_findings: Review of multimodal cannabinoid analgesic mechanisms via CB1, CB2, GPR55 and TRPV1.
Cannabinoid-opioid cross-modulation contributes to antinociception and tolerance.
